nodes.label: Monolithic useStore Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Monolithic useStore has been split into isolated Zustand stores (useChunkStore, useInventoryStore, useFlareStore) to prevent re-rendering and save memory.

nodes.label: Strangler Fig Interceptors
nodes.rationale: worldActions.js uses proxy interceptors inside setState to forward legacy patch.droppedItems and patch.chunks updates to decoupled stores without breaking legacy code.

nodes.label: Custom AABB Frustum Culling
nodes.rationale: Disables native Three.js sphere culling (which fails for 320-block tall chunks) and evaluates custom Box3 intersection against globalFrustum in useFrame.

nodes.label: Zustand Decoupling Bug Fixes
nodes.rationale: Fixed legacy droppedItems zombie state desync, silent block failures (fixed worldActions reading new chunks via legacy bindings), and far-away chunk memory leaks (fixed unloadChunk undefined chunks via useChunkStore.getState().chunks).
